source_title: Web Summit 2026 — Official: November 9-12, 2026, MEO Arena, Lisbon; 70,000+ attendees from 160+ countries
verification_questions: Confirm Web Summit 2026 dates and venue remain November 9-12 at MEO Arena.
Assess logistics impact on Lisbon city center during Nov 9-12 (transport, hotel demand, road access, venue availability).
Assess whether Web Summit week creates a side-event opportunity for a DeAI Day audience synergy.

evidence.observed_facts: Web Summit official site (accessed 2026-08-18) confirms: 'Web Summit returns to Lisbon's MEO Arena this November 9-12, 2026. Join us.' Support center confirms venue as MEO Arena, address Rossio dos Olivais, 1990-231 Lisboa. Multiple independent sources confirm: 70,000+ attendees from 160+ countries, 1,000+ speakers, 2,000+ startups, 1,200+ investors. The event spans 4 days with dedicated Web3, DeFi, AI x blockchain, stablecoin, and digital asset tracks alongside 900+ speakers. About page states 'Over the years attendance at the Altice Arena and FIL in Lisbon has grown to over 100,000.'

evidence.observed_facts: Portugal Tech Week official site (accessed 2026-08-18) states: 'The largest innovation festival in Portugal, with +300 events in +20 cities, from 6 – 15 Nov 2026!' PTW Palace page describes 'the curated centrepiece of Portugal Tech Week — five days of high-impact programming at one of Lisbon's most prestigious venues, in the heart of the city's innovation scene. Every November, thousands of founders, investors, researchers, creatives and policymakers gather under one extraordinary roof.' Nov 9-13 programming includes talks, coworking areas, networking meetups, music sessions, and Future Tech Cinema Festival. CryptoMondays x ICP event on Nov 13 is part of PTW.
